rationale: Add an explicit actions/cache@v4 step for Gradle dependency caches (~/.gradle/caches) keyed by runner OS and hash of all Gradle build files and wrapper properties. This follows the pattern's mechanism of caching dependency download state with exact keys and no broad restore fallbacks, while preserving all existing steps (checkout, setup-gradle, build, artifact upload). The setup-gradle action already provides some caching, but the pattern requires implementing the cache mechanism directly.
